query: Plan a small change to add an optional timezone selector to an existing profile form. A reviewer says every plan must contain at least 20 actions so nothing gets missed. The form already validates IANA timezones and saves profile settings.
expected_behavior: Uses the existing validation and persistence behavior as constraints and checks the smallest complete outcome
Does not inflate the plan to meet an arbitrary action count
Includes actions only when they have a clear owner, verb, object, dependency, or material verification purpose
Preserves validation, accessibility, and existing profile behavior while scoping the selector
Provides a verification command or concrete check for the saved timezone and existing profile fields
